title: Google AI-Generated Search Summary Reportedly Falsely Implicated Canadian Musician in Sexual Offenses, Leading to Concert Cancellation

behaviors.text: A Google Search AI-generated summary reportedly falsely stated that Canadian musician Ashley MacIsaac had been convicted of sexual offenses, apparently due to mistaken identity.
After a venue reportedly relied on the AI-generated information, a scheduled concert was cancelled.
The reported false summary caused reputational and economic harm and left the musician concerned for his personal safety.
